title: Amazon Fire TV, model AFTDEC012E (codename ginza), Android 11 (SDK 30), build RS8185.3885N
header:
Amazon Fire TV, model AFTDEC012E (codename ginza), Android 11 (SDK 30), build RS8185.3885N
Tested on one unit, Fire OS (Amazon), so no Google services.

FIRE OS: DEBLOAT ONLY. Amazon's launcher (com.amazon.tv.launcher) keeps Home, and its packages and components
cannot be disabled ("Cannot disable a protected package"), so this list does not install a launcher. It removes
Amazon's ads, telemetry and preloads. Details and what was tested: docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md, "Fire TV (Fire OS)".

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-aftdec012e/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/amazon-fire-tv-aftdec012e/debloat.txt com.amazon.tv.launcher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Kept on purpose: Alexa, OTA updates, DIAL/whisperplay (Netflix and YouTube casting), Netflix, YouTube, Prime
Video, voice search and the stock launcher. Miracast, MiniTV, Disney+ and Tubi are listed at the bottom, commented
out, for the owner to decide.
